title: Evaluating Debiasing Techniques for Intersectional Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating average and maximum violations of True Positive Rate (equality of opportunity) across overlapping 'gerrymandering' subgroups defined by combinations of multiple sensitive attributes.

Measuring True Positive Rate violations in hate speech detection and occupation classification tasks across gender groups, evaluating them both as independent groups and within intersectional combinations.
Measuring True Positive Rate violations in a Twitter hate speech detection task across racial groups (white vs. other), evaluating them both independently and intersectionally.
Measuring True Positive Rate violations in a Twitter hate speech detection task across age groups (above or below median), evaluating them both independently and intersectionally.
Measuring True Positive Rate violations in a Twitter hate speech detection task across author locations (US vs. not US), evaluating them both independently and intersectionally.

Measuring True Positive Rate violations in an occupation classification task across economic status groups (wealthy vs. rest, based on the individual's country), evaluating them both independently and intersectionally.
